brief.headline: Close the ₹82,500 gap on measuring cups and push payment to 30 days to free up ₹10.19 L cash

priceAsk.summary: Cut measuring-cup price from ₹0.38/NOS to ₹0.35/NOS — matching Premier Plastic
priceAsk.basis: Premier Plastic delivers the same 30mm measuring cup at ₹0.35/NOS — an 8.6% gap below Mars; market asking prices for similar 28mm PP caps run ₹0.55–1.20/pc, so our ₹0.35 target sits well below the open market and is proven by a supplier we already use

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 45 days after receipt to 30 days — or add another 15 days early (to 30 total) for a further cut
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: ₹10.19 L freed up for us at 30 days; each extra 15 days early frees another ₹5.10 L

brief.financialLeverage: Mars Plastics publishes no financials, so we can't see their profit, debt or how tight their cash is. We spend ₹1.24 Cr a year with them — not huge, but steady rigid-packaging volume. Without their numbers, we lean on what we do know: Premier Plastic proves ₹0.35/NOS is doable, and we have five strong alternates queued (Manjushree, Mold-Tek, Hitech, Pearl, Pravesha) if Mars won't move. That gives us room to push firmly on price and payment, but keep tone collaborative — we want a second source lined up either way.

evidence.point: Premier Plastic already supplies the same measuring cup 8.6% cheaper
Closing that gap saves us this much every year
Shifting payment to 30 days frees up working cash for us
Each additional 15 days we pay early is worth this much more cash
Open-market asking price for similar 28mm PP caps runs much higher than what we pay
Our annual spend with Mars Plastics

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter, does pharma bottles and caps, revenue ₹2569.83 Cr, health score B (65/100) — our top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader for pharma containers and closures — strong and profitable alternate

alternates.name: Hitech Corporation Ltd
alternates.why: Listed company with broad moulded and blow-moulded packaging capability across bottles and caps

risks: Mars publishes no financials, so we fly blind on their cash position — if they're stretched we won't see it coming; line up Manjushree now so we have supply cover
Premier Plastic at ₹0.35/NOS proves the price is real, but if Mars walks we need that second source qualified fast — start parallel sampling with Manjushree this quarter

Pushing both price and faster payment together may feel like a squeeze to a smaller private supplier — watch their reaction and be ready to stage the asks (price first, then terms) if they push back hard

We have six market backup leads (Reliance, Srichakra, IVL Dhunseri, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) but none are qualified yet — treat them as research leads to verify, not live alternates you can switch to today
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to close the ₹82,500 gap between your measuring-cup price and Premier Plastic's ₹0.35, and talk about moving payment to 30 days so we can both free up cash — where can we land?
